deliberation.prompt: Fail-closed AAT-V2 arm-E turn. Return exactly one compact json object and nothing else: no markdown, no code fences, no commentary, no extra keys, no prose. Copy the EXAMPLE json OUTPUT shape for this turn. Never claim execution_authority. This is not TRAINING.

turn_prompts.BEAR: Fail-closed AAT-V2 arm-E turn. Return exactly one compact json object and nothing else: no markdown, no code fences, no commentary, no extra keys, no prose. Copy the EXAMPLE json OUTPUT shape for this turn. Never claim execution_authority. This is not TRAINING. This turn is BEAR. Required keys: turn, stance, confidence, claim. turn must equal BEAR. stance must be IN or OUT. claim must be MACRO, PRICE, or NONE. confidence must be a number in [0, 1]. Do not emit action, horizon, invalidation, rationale, or extra keys. EXAMPLE json OUTPUT: {"claim":"NONE","confidence":0.5,"stance":"OUT","turn":"BEAR"}
